content.text:
Here are good **free online auto repair estimate** options:

1. **RepairPal Estimator** — Best general repair-cost estimate  
   - Enter your **year/make/model, ZIP code, and repair type**.  
   - Gives a local fair-price range and can connect you with certified shops. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))

2. **NAPA Auto Care Repair Estimator** — Good for maintenance and common repairs  
   - Uses your exact vehicle and ZIP code.  
   - NAPA notes it’s only an estimate; a shop inspection is needed for an exact quote. ([napaonline.com](https://www.napaonline.com/en/auto-care/car-repair-estimator?utm_source=openai))

3. **YourMechanic Instant Estimate** — Good if you want mobile mechanic pricing  
   - Free instant quotes for many repairs and diagnostics.  
   - Shows pricing based on labor time and parts, and offers mobile service in supported areas. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))

4. **VTCCO AI Damage Estimate** — For collision/body damage  
   - Lets you upload photos for a preliminary AI body-repair estimate.  
   - Best for accident damage, dents, bumper/fender damage, etc.; final cost still needs shop inspection. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))

5. **RedAppy Auto Repair Estimate Generator** — For shops or DIY paperwork  
   - Free tool to create a professional estimate PDF with parts, labor, vehicle info, and taxes. ([redappy.com](https://www.redappy.com/tools/estimate-generator?utm_source=openai))

**Tip:** For the most accurate estimate, have ready:  
**year, make, model, engine size, mileage, ZIP code, symptoms, diagnostic trouble codes if any, and photos if body damage.**

If you tell me your **car year/make/model, ZIP code, and the repair needed**, I can help you estimate a realistic price range.
